content:
Latest macOS 26.7 beta appears to have leaked a lot of information about several upcoming Apple smart home products. These include an all-new HomePod mini, a security camera, a new-generation Siri Remote to pair with the next-gen Apple TV 4K, and the much-anticipated HomePad device.

Further digging into the code seems to provide several important clues about the HomePad…

Engadget's Filipe Espósito discovered that although the HomePad will most likely run some variant of tvOS, it may function more like a larger version of the Apple Watch.

The code also points to a rather interesting privacy feature: widgets will only display your personal information when they detect that your iPhone is nearby.

We expect the HomePad to come in two versions – one with a speaker base, which may look similar to a HomePod, and another designed for wall-mounted installation.

Beyond the other Apple smart home products I mentioned above, there are other unknown devices mentioned as well. I'm really hoping one of them will be a smart doorbell. Which Apple smart home products are you particularly looking forward to? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments.
